method: Read-only lsof process/parent/descriptor/PIPE endpoint snapshots during existing host_replay tests. IDs and endpoint addresses replaced by stable labels within each observation; paths and unrelated environment fields omitted.
interpretation: Separate sibling test processes share an output endpoint. Observation B additionally shows propagation from one sibling into its own CLI child.
limit: Snapshots establish simultaneous endpoint ownership; they do not establish a >=200ms interval in the same run as a LEAK marker.
